agent_report.notes: ~60% coverage. The well-supported technical claims (p-11B reaction, 8.7 MeV, three alpha particles, two-laser system, direct conversion, aneutronic benefits) are thoroughly covered by the Springer paper (already in iter-03) plus the two new sources. The uncovered claims are marketing statements from HB11's JS-heavy website that no independent source replicates. The 'conventional steam cycle' claim in the orig file is particularly interesting — it contradicts every other source including HB11's own Springer paper, which emphasizes direct conversion. The orig file itself flagged this contradiction. The Springer paper (link-10-1007-s10894-023-00349-9) already in iter-03 is the highest-quality source and covers the core technical content comprehensively.
